intended_effect: The interpolation guesser runs from any step directory. The informational workdir field is expressed relative to the repository root, falling back to the absolute path, so a layout change cannot lose already-built guesses.
scope: any step whose scratch directory is outside tools/, i.e. every step under the current layout
diff: workdir relative to REPO instead of WS, with a fallback

trigger_evidence: Bar-resolution probe run: every generator in the ladder resolved its sibling imports and the atom mapper under WS/resources/tools/, the retired workspace layout. 13 such sites across six files. The mapper call is wrapped in 'except Exception -> print WARNING', so nothing raised: the run logged 'heavy-atom mapping failed: can't open .../tools/resources/tools/map_reaction_atoms.py' and continued on an element-grouped nearest-neighbour map.
intended_effect: Every generator resolves its dependencies against the repository root. scripts/qa/test_guess_ladder.py imports each generator, checks every repo-relative constant resolves, and refuses the retired layout by name.
scope: all guess generators; every reaction kind that goes through the ladder

trigger_evidence: With the paths fixed the mapper ran but its output was still unreadable by the ladder: heavy_atom_map reads map_result['mappings'][0]['reactant_to_product'], while this mapper's --json-out wrote compact_mapping_records(), a five-field subset that drops reactant_to_product. The consumer's exception handler turned that into the same silent nearest-neighbour fallback, so guesses were produced from a degraded mapping with no error.
intended_effect: The mapper each asset set carries matches the contract that set's consumers read: the final set writes the full record its guess ladder needs, the initial set keeps the compact record its skills read. A mapping failure can no longer masquerade as a successful guess.
scope: every guess generator that atom-maps reactant to product
diff: final and live tree take the full-record mapper; initial set unchanged
